title: dedicated: autoscaling burst controls and fleet utilization reporting
author: Ariana Chen
release_notes: Adds configurable per-fleet burst budgets and exports fleet utilization metrics. No customer-facing API changes. Admin console gains a utilization report page.
description: Motivation: Dedicated customers sometimes need short-term throughput bursts above committed capacity (e.g. marketing spikes) but we need predictable overall utilization guarantees and observability. This PR introduces: 1) configurable burst budgets per dedicated fleet with leak-rate enforcement and hard/soft limits; 2) autoscaler integration that accounts for burst headroom when deciding scale actions; 3) new fleet-level utilization metrics and a console report endpoint; 4) a DB migration to persist burst configs; 5) unit and integration tests. Design notes: Burst budgets are tracked as token buckets per-fleet. The burst_controller enforces a configurable max_burst_tokens and refill_rate; requests consume tokens atomically and will fall back to a queued or cheaper model variant when exhausted. The autoscaler samples both steady-state utilization and burst-adjusted utilization and uses a weighted decision function to avoid scaling up for short-lived bursts. Metrics added: dedicated.fleet.burst_tokens_used, dedicated.fleet.burst_tokens_available, dedicated.fleet.utilization_5m, dedicated.pool.provisioned_gpus. The console exposes a new /admin/dedicated/fleets/:id/utilization route that shows recent utilization, burst consumption, and recommendations to increase reserved capacity. Rollout plan: feature flag gated for 72h dogfood in staging, then enable for 2 pilot customers, then gradual rollout. Migration: adds burst_config JSON column to dedicated_fleets table; migration includes backfill default config (max_burst_tokens=0) to avoid changing existing behavior. Testing: added unit tests for token accounting and integration test that exercises autoscaler decisions under synthetic burst traffic. Checklist:- [x] Implementation of burst controller and integration with request path- [x] Metrics emitted and registered in metrics_registry- [x] DB migration and backfill script- [x] Console report and api route- [x] Unit and integration tests- [x] Feature flag gating and rollout notes Related: ENG-2984 for autoscaler pricing considerations, PM-412 for product acceptance criteria, SUP-1123 for customer request.
